full_judgment:
2. Short facts essential for disposal of these petition are that the petitioner as preemptor filed Miscellaneous Case No. 14 of 1996 in the Court of Senior Assistant Judge, Sadar, Noakhali under Section 24 of the Non Agricultural Tenancy Act or in the alternative under section 96 of State Acquisition and Tenancy Act 1950, for preemption of the case land. The preemptor at the same time also filed a suit being Title Suit No. 67 in the same Court for declaration that the so called ewaj Deed No. 15836 dated 28.11.1995 was an out and out sale deed. 

 4. From the impugned judgment and order, it appears that the High Court Division did not enter into the merit of the suit as well as the miscellaneous case and did not decide the issues involved therein. It took objection to the analogous hearing of the suit and he miscellaneous case, the nature of the suit and the miscellaneous case being different. However, it appears that the High Court Division made general observation as to when the exchange deed assumed the character of sale deed. It also observed that the property in the suit was a town property, as such, it had to be decided first whether "it is pre-emtable under section 96 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act or under section 24 of the Non agricultural Tenancy Act." but did not decide the question with reference to the evidence on record though the entire records were before it; hence these petitions for leave to appeal.
